before-starting-the-fremennik-trials.npc: Ah! Outerlander! Do not interrupt me in my business! I must cull these fiends!

before-starting-the-fremennik-trials.player: What are you doing down here?

before-starting-the-fremennik-trials.npc: Only an outerlander would ask such a question! Is it not obvious what I am doing?
I kill the daggermouths for glory and for sport! When I have had my fill, I move on to the daggermouths' lair!

before-starting-the-fremennik-trials.player: Erm... okay then. I'll leave you to it.

before-starting-the-fremennik-trials-usi.npc: I do not trust you outerlander, I will not accept your gifts, no matter what your intention...

after-completing-the-fremennik-trials.player: Hello there Bardur. How's it going?

after-completing-the-fremennik-trials.npc: I have been here all the long day, slaughtering the daggermouth spawns so that none may pass!
My sword arm grows weary, and the blood of my foes hangs heavy upon my clothing!

after-completing-the-fremennik-trials.player: Can you tell me anything about the caves down here?

after-completing-the-fremennik-trials.npc: Aye, that I can [Fremennik name]! Yonder lies the lair of the daggermouth kings, the three beasts of legend!
I train my skills upon its foul brood, to prepare myself for the fight ahead!

after-completing-the-fremennik-trials.player: Okay, thanks Bardur. Do you have any food with you?

after-completing-the-fremennik-trials.npc: Ah, you did not come prepared [Fremennik name]?
I have nothing to spare, but my equipment grows weaker under the onslaught of the dagger-mouth spawns!
I will trade you a finely cooked shark if you have a replacement for my helm, my shield or my blade...
Give me any equipment you wish to trade, and I will pay you a shark for it.

after-completing-the-fremennik-trials-us.npc: Ah, just what I was looking for! You wish to trade me that for a cooked shark?

steps.npc: Ah, this will serve me well as a backup! My thanks to you [Fremennik name], I trust we will one day sing songs together of glorious battles in the Rellekka longhall!
As you wish, [Fremennik name] My weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.

after-completing-the-fremennik-trials-us.npc: No [Fremennik name], I will trade you my finely cooked shark for a trusty Fremennik blade, a sturdy Fremennik helm, or a mighty Fremennik shield...
I have no interest in that... thing... you are trying to offload on me.

after-completing-the-fremennik-exiles.player: Hello there Bardur. How's it going?

after-completing-the-fremennik-exiles.npc: Listen, [Fremennik name]. I'm sorry about the way I acted while you were exiled. Bardur gets hostile around outerlanders.

after-completing-the-fremennik-exiles.player: Don't worry about it, I understand! All's well that ends well! How've you been?
